findings.problem: Without a hint, "to advise" could just as well be answered with beraten (to advise or counsel someone) or empfehlen (to recommend), both common verbs.
findings.fix: hint: tell someone what you think they should do, as in I ___ you to stay; not beraten or empfehlen

back.target: to advise (someone to do something), to recommend; also to guess
back.example: I advise you to stay at home today.

note: The Spanish list has consejo (advice) only as a noun and no verb for to advise, so sameAs null is right.
